title: Western Star Custom Built FUPS Hi-tensile Aluminium Road Train Bullbar #10
description: Western Star hi-tensile FUPS approved aluminium polished Bullbar for 4800/4900 series. Five post design with extra height outer box uprights and additional cross tube for maximum protection. All cross tubes are one piece passing through the drilled uprights, no but welds. Tow plate cover is black but other finishes available or chrome plated. Fold down aluminium Road Train signs, cow catcher with three small uprights. Built with 88mm diameter pipe. Heavy duty backing plate with heavy duty tow pin, ideal for dolly work. Custom driving light mounts as required, bar mounted indicator repeater light. Front mudflap bar standard.
